verses.pali: Aṅguttara Nikāya 10.216
verses.english: Numbered Discourses 10.216

verses.pali: 21. Karajakāyavagga
verses.english: 21. The Body Born of Deeds

verses.pali: Saṁsappanīyasutta
verses.english: Creepy Creatures

verses.pali: “Saṁsappanīyapariyāyaṁ vo, bhikkhave, dhammapariyāyaṁ desessāmi.
verses.english: “Mendicants, I will teach you an exposition of the teaching on creepy creatures.

verses.pali: Taṁ suṇātha, sādhukaṁ manasi karotha, bhāsissāmī”ti.
verses.english: Listen and apply your mind well, I will speak.”

verses.pali: “Evaṁ, bhante”ti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṁ.
verses.english: “Yes, sir,” they replied.

verses.pali: Bhagavā etadavoca:
verses.english: The Buddha said this:

verses.pali: “Katamo ca, bhikkhave, saṁsappanīyapariyāyo dhammapariyāyo?
verses.english: “What is the exposition of the teaching on creepy creatures?

verses.pali: Kammassakā, bhikkhave, sattā kammadāyādā kammayonī kammabandhū kammapaṭisaraṇā, yaṁ kammaṁ karonti—
verses.english: Sentient beings are the owners of their deeds and heir to their deeds. Deeds are their womb, their relative, and their refuge.

verses.pali: kalyāṇaṁ vā pāpakaṁ vā—tassa dāyādā bhavanti.
verses.english: They shall be the heir of whatever deeds they do, whether good or bad.

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco pāṇātipātī hoti luddo lohitapāṇi hatapahate niviṭṭho, adayāpanno sabbapāṇabhūtesu.
verses.english: Take a certain someone who kills living creatures. They’re violent, bloody-handed, a hardened killer, merciless to living beings.

verses.pali: So saṁsappati kāyena, saṁsappati vācāya, saṁsappati manasā.
verses.english: They’re creepy in body, speech, and mind.

verses.pali: Tassa jimhaṁ kāyakammaṁ hoti, jimhaṁ vacīkammaṁ, jimhaṁ manokammaṁ, jimhā gati, jimhupapatti.
verses.english: Doing crooked deeds by way of body, speech, and mind, their destiny and rebirth are crooked.

verses.pali: Jimhagatikassa kho panāhaṁ, bhikkhave, jimhupapattikassa dvinnaṁ gatīnaṁ aññataraṁ gatiṁ vadāmi—
verses.english: Someone whose destiny and rebirth is crooked is reborn in one of two places, I say:

verses.pali: ye vā ekantadukkhā nirayā yā vā saṁsappajātikā tiracchānayoni.
verses.english: in an exclusively painful hell, or among the species of creepy animals.

verses.pali: Katamā ca sā, bhikkhave, saṁsappajātikā tiracchānayoni?
verses.english: And what are the species of creepy animals?

verses.pali: Ahi vicchikā satapadī nakulā biḷārā mūsikā ulūkā, ye vā panaññepi keci tiracchānayonikā sattā manusse disvā saṁsappanti.
verses.english: Snakes, scorpions, centipedes, mongooses, cats, mice, owls, or whatever other species of animal that creep away when they see humans.

verses.pali: Iti kho, bhikkhave, bhūtā bhūtassa upapatti hoti.
verses.english: This is how a being is born from a being.

verses.pali: Yaṁ karoti tena upapajjati.
verses.english: For your deeds determine your rebirth,

verses.pali: Upapannamenaṁ phassā phusanti.
verses.english: and when you’re reborn contacts strike you.

verses.pali: Evamahaṁ, bhikkhave, ‘kammadāyādā sattā’ti vadāmi.
verses.english: This is why I say that sentient beings are heirs to their deeds.

verses.pali: Idha pana, bhikkhave, ekacco adinnādāyī hoti …pe…
verses.english: Take someone else who steals …

verses.pali: kāmesumicchācārī hoti …
verses.english: commits sexual misconduct …

verses.pali: musāvādī hoti …
verses.english: lies …

verses.pali: pisuṇavāco hoti …
verses.english: backbites …

verses.pali: pharusavāco hoti …
verses.english: speaks harshly …

verses.pali: samphappalāpī hoti …
verses.english: indulges in talking nonsense …

verses.pali: abhijjhālu hoti …
verses.english: is covetous …

verses.pali: byāpannacitto hoti …
verses.english: has cruel intentions …

verses.pali: micchādiṭṭhiko hoti viparītadassano:
verses.english: has wrong view …

verses.pali: ‘natthi dinnaṁ …pe…
sayaṁ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedentī’ti.
So saṁsappati kāyena, saṁsappati vācāya, saṁsappati manasā.
verses.english: They’re creepy in body, speech, and mind.

verses.pali: Tassa jimhaṁ kāyakammaṁ hoti, jimhaṁ vacīkammaṁ, jimhaṁ manokammaṁ, jimhā gati, jimhupapatti.
verses.english: Doing crooked deeds by way of body, speech, and mind, their destiny and rebirth are crooked.

verses.pali: Jimhagatikassa kho panāhaṁ, bhikkhave, jimhupapattikassa dvinnaṁ gatīnaṁ aññataraṁ gatiṁ vadāmi—
verses.english: Someone whose destiny and rebirth is crooked is reborn in one of two places, I say:

verses.pali: ye vā ekantadukkhā nirayā yā vā saṁsappajātikā tiracchānayoni.
verses.english: in an exclusively painful hell, or among the species of creepy animals.

verses.pali: Katamā ca sā, bhikkhave, saṁsappajātikā tiracchānayoni?
verses.english: And what are the species of creepy animals?

verses.pali: Ahi vicchikā satapadī nakulā biḷārā mūsikā ulūkā, ye vā panaññepi keci tiracchānayonikā sattā manusse disvā saṁsappanti.
verses.english: Snakes, scorpions, centipedes, mongooses, cats, mice, owls, or whatever other species of animal that creep away when they see humans.

verses.pali: Iti kho, bhikkhave, bhūtā bhūtassa upapatti hoti,
verses.english: This is how a being is born from a being.

verses.pali: yaṁ karoti tena upapajjati.
verses.english: For your deeds determine your rebirth,

verses.pali: Upapannamenaṁ phassā phusanti.
verses.english: and when you’re reborn contacts strike you.

verses.pali: Evamahaṁ, bhikkhave, ‘kammadāyādā sattā’ti vadāmi.
verses.english: This is why I say that sentient beings are heirs to their deeds.

verses.pali: Kammassakā, bhikkhave, sattā kammadāyādā kammayonī kammabandhū kammapaṭisaraṇā, yaṁ kammaṁ karonti—
verses.english: Sentient beings are the owners of their deeds and heir to their deeds. Deeds are their womb, their relative, and their refuge.

verses.pali: kalyāṇaṁ vā pāpakaṁ vā—tassa dāyādā bhavanti.
verses.english: They shall be the heir of whatever deeds they do, whether good or bad.

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco pāṇātipātaṁ pahāya pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti nihitadaṇḍo nihitasattho, lajjī dayāpanno sabbapāṇabhūtahitānukampī viharati.
verses.english: Take a certain someone who gives up killing living creatures. They renounce the rod and the sword. They’re scrupulous and kind, living full of sympathy for all living beings.

verses.pali: So na saṁsappati kāyena, na saṁsappati vācāya, na saṁsappati manasā.
verses.english: They’re not creepy in body, speech, and mind.

verses.pali: Tassa uju kāyakammaṁ hoti, uju vacīkammaṁ, uju manokammaṁ, uju gati, ujupapatti.
verses.english: Doing virtuous deeds by way of body, speech, and mind, their destiny and rebirth is virtuous.

verses.pali: Ujugatikassa kho panāhaṁ, bhikkhave, ujupapattikassa dvinnaṁ gatīnaṁ aññataraṁ gatiṁ vadāmi—
verses.english: Someone whose destiny and rebirth is virtuous is reborn in one of two places, I say:

verses.pali: ye vā ekantasukhā saggā yāni vā pana tāni uccākulāni khattiyamahāsālakulāni vā brāhmaṇamahāsālakulāni vā gahapatimahāsālakulāni vā aḍḍhāni mahaddhanāni mahābhogāni pahūtajātarūparajatāni pahūtavittūpakaraṇāni pahūtadhanadhaññāni.
verses.english: in a heaven of perfect happiness, or in an eminent well-to-do family of aristocrats, brahmins, or householders—rich, affluent, and wealthy, with lots of gold and silver, lots of property and assets, and lots of money and grain.

verses.pali: Iti kho, bhikkhave, bhūtā bhūtassa upapatti hoti.
verses.english: This is how a being is born from a being.

verses.pali: Yaṁ karoti tena upapajjati.
verses.english: For your deeds determine your rebirth,

verses.english: and when you’re reborn contacts strike you.

verses.pali: Evamahaṁ, bhikkhave, ‘kammadāyādā sattā’ti vadāmi.
verses.english: This is why I say that sentient beings are heirs to their deeds.

verses.pali: Idha pana, bhikkhave, ekacco adinnādānaṁ pahāya adinnādānā paṭivirato hoti …pe…
verses.english: Take someone else who gives up stealing …

verses.pali: pisuṇaṁ vācaṁ pahāya pisuṇāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti …
verses.english: backbiting …

verses.pali: pharusaṁ vācaṁ pahāya pharusāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti …
verses.english: harsh speech …

verses.pali: samphappalāpaṁ pahāya samphappalāpā paṭivirato hoti …
verses.english: talking nonsense …

verses.pali: anabhijjhālu hoti …
verses.english: They’re content …

verses.pali: abyāpannacitto hoti …
verses.english: kind hearted …

verses.pali: sammādiṭṭhiko hoti aviparītadassano:
verses.english: they have right view …

verses.pali: ‘atthi dinnaṁ …pe…
ye imañca lokaṁ parañca lokaṁ sayaṁ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedentī’ti.
So na saṁsappati kāyena, na saṁsappati vācāya, na saṁsappati manasā.
verses.english: They’re not creepy in body, speech, and mind.

verses.pali: Tassa uju kāyakammaṁ hoti, uju vacīkammaṁ, uju manokammaṁ, uju gati, ujupapatti.
verses.english: Doing virtuous deeds by way of body, speech, and mind, their destiny and rebirth is virtuous.

verses.pali: Ujugatikassa kho pana ahaṁ, bhikkhave, ujupapattikassa dvinnaṁ gatīnaṁ aññataraṁ gatiṁ vadāmi—
verses.english: Someone whose destiny and rebirth is virtuous is reborn in one of two places, I say:

verses.pali: ye vā ekantasukhā saggā yāni vā pana tāni uccākulāni khattiyamahāsālakulāni vā brāhmaṇamahāsālakulāni vā gahapatimahāsālakulāni vā aḍḍhāni mahaddhanāni mahābhogāni pahūtajātarūparajatāni pahūtavittūpakaraṇāni pahūtadhanadhaññāni.
verses.english: in a heaven of perfect happiness, or in an eminent well-to-do family of aristocrats, brahmins, or householders—rich, affluent, and wealthy, with lots of gold and silver, lots of property and assets, and lots of money and grain.

verses.pali: Iti kho, bhikkhave, bhūtā bhūtassa upapatti hoti.
verses.english: This is how a being is born from a being.

verses.pali: Yaṁ karoti tena upapajjati.
verses.english: For your deeds determine your rebirth,

verses.pali: Upapannamenaṁ phassā phusanti.
verses.english: and when you’re reborn contacts strike you.

verses.pali: Evamahaṁ, bhikkhave, ‘kammadāyādā sattā’ti vadāmi.
verses.english: This is why I say that sentient beings are heirs to their deeds.

verses.pali: Kammassakā, bhikkhave, sattā kammadāyādā kammayonī kammabandhū kammapaṭisaraṇā, yaṁ kammaṁ karonti—
verses.english: Sentient beings are the owners of their deeds and heir to their deeds. Deeds are their womb, their relative, and their refuge.

verses.pali: kalyāṇaṁ vā pāpakaṁ vā—tassa dāyādā bhavanti.
verses.english: They shall be the heir of whatever deeds they do, whether good or bad.

verses.pali: Ayaṁ kho so, bhikkhave, saṁsappanīyapariyāyo dhammapariyāyo”ti.
verses.english: This is the exposition of the teaching on creepy creatures.”

verses.pali: Chaṭṭhaṁ.
